It is a feminist, woke, politically correct weak boyfriend simulator..  on top of that it's the most anti-consumwr piede of software ever released.  No physical media, 30 fps and buggy as all get out.  Worst of all they added a empathy/morality system to a game named after a felony!  Rockstar has completely lost the plot! author: Exlee3000
quote: Quite simply this not only one of the best indie games but one of the best games of all-time!  This game is the epitome of why I game.  It is so blatantly obvious that every inch of this game was crafted with passion and a love of gaming.  This is a first person RPG/metroidvania with astonishing lore, graphics and gameplay.  It starts slowly with just a rusty sword and the enemies are tough.  The key is holding your stamina to the max to give more powerful shots and dodging the enemies' attacks.  Spamming the attack button will get you killed quickly.  Also early on you'll find a throwing weapon holster for throwing knives.  This is also an important key to rhe gameplay because you''ll be attacked by sneaky ranged attack enemies at all times.  The other cool thing is weapons evolve with use.  So soon your rusty sword becomes a powerful magical sword.  The next thing that makes this game phenomenal is the exploration!  There are literally secrets everywhere.  Your curiosity is ALWAYS rewarded.  It truly is so fun.  There are so many weapons and treasure to find.  The amount of content they pack in a small area is amazing.  One of the other cool things about this game is in addition to the wide open world there is also a ton of vertical exploration.  You always see new places to get to above you.  A key aspect to this exploration is your sword that allows you to fly  horizontally in bursts.  As you get more wind stones you'll be able to glide further and further and find new areas.  The fimal thing I'll comment on is how brilliantly interconnected the world is.  My jaw would always hit the floor when I saw how crazily they connected everything.  There's so much more to say but I'll save the joy of discovery for yourselves because that's what makes this game so good!  Honestly this is one of the best games ever made and I am certain it will be played for years and be considered an instant classic!   Support this game!  Highly, highly recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: When this game was first announced as a full single player game I was bryond happy as I could not care less about asymetrical  4v1 multiplayer games!  Having just finished the game I can confidently say Mad Head Games and Saber Serbia absolutely nailed it!  It is so obvioys the devs had profound love and passion for the source material.  Unlike mosern woke games who hate the source material and try to subvert it at every turn.  This game is a love letter to the source material.  I am certain Clive Barker is elated with what they've accomplished!  The gameplay is a mix between levels in the real world and those in the Labyrinth.  And in my opinion it is perfectly paced.  You have a mix of melee weapons and guns.  All of which are fun to use in different circumstances.  But  some of the most fun is using the genesis configuration box.  You get telekenesis, pyrokenesis and an attack similar to a rage attack you build up.  All are also fun to use.  The story, writing, sound, music, character designs, and graphics are all top-notch.  But one of the best parts is Doug Bradley reprising his role as Pinhead!  And let me tell you he absolutely crushes it.  This is without question one of the best licensed games of all time!  And holy crap that ending!  I pray we get a sequel!  They should do Clive Barker's Raw Head Rex next!  That would be fire.  One last note this game is adult content as a game can get, so if you're sensitive this may not be for you!  But I loved every second!  Highly, highly recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Yes this game has a lot of controls and systems to come to grips with but it's not that bad. I guess growing up playing brutal 8 bit and 16 bit games I didn't find it a big deal.  But boy did developer Pearl Abyss deliver an amazing game.  I'm playing on the PS5 Pro and the game is stunning!  The music, voice acting and combat are also top-notch.  But the best part of this game is the exploration!  I truly feel like an adventurer who has stepped into a fully realized medievel fantasy world.  You can literally go anywhere on the map you see.  And it is always rewarding.  There's always something cool to be found.  There are also a ton of fully realized mini-games like arm-wrestling, gambling and archery.  Just to name a few.   And the narrative keeps getting crapoed on.  Not sure why I'm liking it thus fae.  It's solid.  You star as Kliff who is part **** of warriors called the greymanes.  You were sneak attacked by the Black Bears and your people scattered.  Your goal is to find them and start a camp and figure how all the events are connected.  And you want to talk about value for your money.  To do everything in this game your talking 200 to 300 hours! Tbis game absolutely lived up to the hype and is **** contender.  Highly recommended.  It starts a touch slow but stick with it and you will be rewarded.  My guess is when all the dust settles this will be considered an all-time great!  Do not listen to activist progressive so-called journalists who clearly didn't finish the game and clearly had an ax to grind!  SMH!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Wow this game came out of nowhere and was a surprisingly great games!!  Indie devs are on fire right now and are really the heart of all the creativity, innovation and passion!  Games like Chromagun 2 Dye Hard, AILA,, Sleep Awake, and most especially Escape From Ever After!  Killer experiences much like Crisol!  First off the game is just 18 bucks!  Guys when I tell you if they charged 30 to 35 I would have had no problem and felt it was worth it! believe me  But 18 bucks is a ateal for a game of this length and quality.  The gane is like the 1st person horror version of Lies of P.  Like that game, Crisol has a singular, amazing creative vision focused on a very spanish culture with early 30s to 40s vibes.  The story revolves around 2 factions and their Gods- Sol and the Sea.  You are a soldier sent by the Sol god to deal with the world threat caused by the Sea God.  You play as Gabriel a soldier meant to infiltrate and eliminate the Sea God and his followers.  To aid im this you are granted a gun from Sol.  Herein lies the cool part of the game.  You reload with your blood.  You press a button and spikes come from the gun and drain blood which takes health.  It's really a fun nechanic offering plenty iof risk reward. You start with a handgun but can get 4 iohers.  All are a blast to use with their strength and weakness. You also heal by absorbing the blood of dead animals or people which is fun!  Much of your enemies wlill be different types of creepy dolls which are great.  But there's plenty of other kinds as well.  You'll also have a big invulnerable boss chase you occasionally like the Nemesis from RE 3 or Big Daddy from Bioshock. SHe will definitely scare the bejesus out of you a couple times!  Lol!  And the game was definitely inspired by those 2 games but it definitey does it's own thing and the atmosphere is great highlighted by very goid visuals and killer music.  Overall highly recommended!  For 18 bucks you literalky cannot go wrong if you're a fan of survival horror/adventure!

author: Exlee3000
quote: To the clown who said the graphics are terrible you are clueless imo!  The game is a pixel art game one in the style of a Ps 1 game, but that was very deliberate as it's meant to be a new retro styled game.  To me the graphics are gorgeous with killer parallax scrolling.  Also this was not a cheap cash in.  What it is is a passionate retro studio cold emailed Sony Santa Monica and asked if they could do a retro God of War game.  And their passion and vision won them over so they decided to collaborate.  This was not even Sony's original idea.  All I can say is if you like pixel art metroidvanias with a great story and awesome gameplay then this game is for you.  It starts a touch slow but once you get more skills and power it's a blast.  It isclear this game was made by passionate devs who love God of War and pixrl games!  The game is top-notch and an incredibly pleasant surprise!  Highly recommended!!
game_title: God of War: Sons of Sparta

author: Exlee3000
quote: So the last game from this studio was a little game called Rogue Loops.  It was a solid rogue-like that I quite enjoyed.  Well with their next game they've really stepped up their game.  First off I really like the graphics.  They have a distinct style of cell shaded graphics that I think looks great.  The 2D art in particular is amazing for the characters and loading screen. They've chosen to make the character like a figurine on a plinth like a board game piece. In a diorama.  I like it it but some may nor.  Next is the music which is really, really good.  All the tracks are top-notch.  Next is the gameplsy.  The game is also a rogue-lite with a castle serving as a base of operation.  There various characters will help you along the way as you look to reclaim the land from a traitorous vampire who teamed up with werewolves.  The game is a lot of fun with a lot of power-ups.  Getting OP is a blast.  You also find and nurture side vampires to assist in the levels that you can level up as well.  The game has 12 stages all with a cool boss.  And I like that they mixed a rogue-lite with a survivorr-like and added a campaign.  That's what sets this game apart.  The game has over 25 hours of gamepkay.  And here's the best part, it's only 9.99!! Recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This is a new game from Blumhouse studios.  It's made by the director of Spec ops and music by Robin Finck of Nine Inch Nails.  This is a ver cool experience from beginning to end.  Psychoelic trippy game with great lore and visuals.  The music is also very cool and unique and really adds to the atmosphere.  It's a stealth/lite puzzle game. It is tge perfect 6 hour experience.  It was the perfect change of pace after 100 hours in Where Winds Meet.  Recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: What an absolute joke and dud ****!  Activision has completely and totally lost it's way.  The wokest most off-putting DEI/ESG black girl-boss simulator of a campaign.   It's freaking comical at this point!!  The attack on masculinity and basic reality by these companies must stop!!  This is the epitome of corpirate slop!  Avoid like the plague!  Play Hell is Us a slept on amazing game instead!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Anything less than a 7 for this game is frankly insane and I can almost guarantee they didn't plat past 2 hours.  Admittedly it's a lot to take in at first.  With a lot of menus, character attributes, info, history, lore and a store.  Plus the multi-player side.  But keep pushing through and you will quickly be able to see all the great qualities this game has.  First off for the most part the game is quite beautiful.  Save for some low poly textures and some occasional pop-in, the game can be stunning at times.  With hints of Ghost of Tsushima and beautiful scenery and color everywhere, you really feel transported to this unique and interesting time period.  The beautiful traditional Chinese music also really adds to the immersion.  The next great thing about this game is the exploratiom.  There is literally something cool or new to find around every corner.  And your curiosity will almost always be rewarded with something cool.  Next is the combat, which I'm happy to report is quite good.  So much build variation it's amazing.  But it's definitely got your standard ARPG/Souls-like mechanic with dodging and blocking and parrying.  But this game adds so much variety to the builds that the play styles almost feel like different games.  You'll also learn types of sect magics ane martial arts styles.  They've been fun to play around with.  So you'll find secrets, mini-bosses, bosses and hidden areas everywhere in addition to the main campaign.  So far I'm having a blast.  There are a few minor and not as minor technical difficulties.  As I said there's some pop in and some low/late textures.  But the biggest issue is being thrown from the game for technical reasons.  It's understandable because the game has had over 2 million users in a couple days.  But it's still frustrsting none the less.  Especially when it happened on the second form of a tricky boss fight when I was about 2 secionds before landing the coup de grace!  LOL!  But this will def improve with time and it's not even bad now.  Oh and the best part, it's free.  100% no P2W just cosmetic.  This game has about 120 hours of solo content and it's all available!  In this day and age when so many are struggling financially this really is a blessing!  Oh and it's mercifully un-woke as the Chinese much like myself despise that stuff!!  So bottom line it's free.  Stick with it and you will see it's great quality!

author: Exlee3000
quote: I almost overlooked this amazing game because they worked with Sweet Baby on their last game.  And they are a vile company destroying gaming imo.  But thank goodness they had a trial on Ps Plus premium.  I played it and was won over almost immediately.  The world they created is amazing as is the lore.  And the graphics and art style are very memorable.  But the real star of this title is the gameplay!  So well done and so much fun.  You start the game with knives as your main weapon and a whip.  The whip can be used in combat and is very important.  But it's also integral for exploration.  You use it to swing around and pull yourself up to places and it's a blast to use.  And the whip sound is great.  You also find numerous secondary weapons that have a finite number of uses that you refill by attacking with your main weapon.  On top of that you can affix certain buffs to each weapon that offer all sorts of improvements.  This is a metroid-vania and it's huge!  Exploration is so fun and always rewarded.  There are so many secrets.  And all the upgrades that allow you access to new areas are all very different and fun.  To me this is one of the best metroid-vanias I've played in a long time and just a great game overall.  The game can be challenging but I think the difficulty is perfect.  Unfortunately the damage from working with Sweet Baby might be too mich to overcome.  I also want to say this game feels like a mea culpa from Heart Machine, the devs, from working with Sweet Baby.  There is almost ZERO wokeness in the game. One of my favorite games of the year!  Please don't miss this gem!

author: Exlee3000
quote: What a great game!  Great music, great visuals and great gameplay!  And when played on PSVR 2 and it's truly something transcendent!  Highly, highly recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: My God it's sad how far Obsidian has fallen!  They used to make top-notch quality games like Fallout New Vegas and KOTR and Baldur's Gate.  Games that left an impression for their quality and are classics. Now the company is filled with progressive, feminist activists who prioritize woke propaganda.  Holy crap those character designs are so bland, ugly, off-putting and generic.  They also tick every so called diversity box.  There nary a White or straight person in the game.  Bland and boring missions combined with uninspired gameplay.  And Microsoft has **** the soul out and destroyed yet another company!  SMH!  Avoid this slop at all costs as it's the epitome of everything wrong with modern gaming!

author: Exlee3000
quote: I freakin' love this game!  It's a really well done rogue-like!  You play as a robotic school girl trying to take down a comically evil corporation who works their robot employees 24/7 and turning them into the "working dead" by feeding them this drink that makes them zombie robots.  They also captured your best friend and turned her against you.  So the goal is to make it to the 100th floor to take down the CEO and save your friend.  And the other conceit is you live-stream your runs and people give you money to complete certain actions.  Like beating all the enemies in under 40 seconds or not using a health.  So you build up money this way as well as pick up materials for improving your robot.  It's a great little gameplay loop.  The other super fun part of this game is the destruction!  Almost everything can be smashed or exploded in this office building and it's a joy to do so.  The game is colorful and pleasant graphically and runs great!  A virtual locked 60fps!  This was such a pleasant sueprise.  If you like rogue-likes you should love this!  Alao if you have PS Plus premium there's a 2 hour trial to try it!  Highly recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Killer little indie game!  It's a survivor like mixed with brick breaking and village building lite.  It really works. Throughout the course of the game you'll acquire new characters which each have unique attributes.  Each character shoots balls as their weapon.  So you'll get specialty balls like poison, fire, wind and freeze.  You'll also get other buff items.  The cool system is the fission/evolution system.  After killing enemies you'll get gems and a rainbow icon that allows evolution.  This is where you can combine balls with different attributes to create even better ones.  There are over 60 types of balls to find and discover.  And trying all the new combos is a blast!  Overall I can't recommend this one enough! Along with Blue Prince this is one of my favorite indie games of the year!  Highly recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Terrible performance and filled with woke garbage and cringe writing!  Stick to the first 2.  The last 2 are no good imo!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This is a top-tier game!  It does a great job of showing all sides of war and humanizing all the people involved.  Top-notch writing!  But just as impressive is the world they've created.  The lore and alternate world with the fictional country of Hadea is fully realized. But the gameplay is what really shines!  I'm soneone who loves exploration in games and in that regard this game really delivers.  Your curiosity will always be rewarded with something.  And the combat isn't too shabby either.  This is NOT a souls-like.  But it's got very solid action with a lot of accessories and cutomization.  This game does an amazing job of showing the horror of war tinged with the unique creatures!  I pray this gem doesn't get overlooked with the glut of games being released.  Silksong really kind of screwed it.  But I hope its quality and word of mouth helps it find an audience because it deserves it!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Do not sleep on this game!  The gameplay and music are top-notch but most importantly it respects the source material.  The game is based on the first 12 episodes of the 80s anime.  As you play they seemlessly mix in parts of these episodes.  Which is really well done.  The game is a Metroidvania lite with some secrets only accessable once you get new abilities.  Interestingly the devs that made this game are the same ones who made the classic Baldur's Gate Dark Alliance.  But you have so many different gameplay options with the psychogun, side arm, melee and regular blaster.  It's really fun to use the psycho gun which is a guided laser.  One of the best aspects of the game is that it is 100% free of progressive propaganda!  So we have a masculibe, moral and heroic protagonist and attractive, feminine and likable women.  Unlike most modenr western games! There's a free demo on psn.  So check it out!  Highly recommended!!

author: Exlee3000
quote: What a great game!  It is so clear the devs had love for their subject matter.  Their love of the mafia and Sicilian culture shines through!  The narrative and script is exemplary!  And the voice acting is honestly some of the best all time in a videogame.  And it's these aforementioned factiors that really pull you into this universe!  The graphics, soubd design and music are also top-notch!  Now for the gameplay.  To those saying this is a walking simulator, I think your insane!!  Yiu get horse and car races, knife fights, car chases, car shootouts, stealth missions and tons of regular shootouts.  The opera sequence is a particular highlight.  There are also quite a bit if collectibles. So while not groundbreaking the gameplay is super solid and enjoyable and never gets old during its 15 hour run time.  My only small gripe is I don't think certain characters would have fallen fir certain things but was necessary fir the plot to gi where they wanted. One last thing is this game is based AF.  No DEI/ESG so we get feminine women, masculine men and beauty!!  Halleujah!  Overall I loved this game and hope there's DLC or another game in this world!!  For me it's a GOTY contender along with Blades of Fire, Wuchang and Blue Prince!  Highly recommended!!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Wuchang is a true souls-like in every sense of the word.  It's got the brilliantly interconnected world just like From Soft with all their short cuts, lore and secrets!  I loved slowly exploring all this land had to offer.  And it was always rewarded.  Gameplay is also very good but it's a lot to take in at first.  But over time the complex systems reveal themselves.  On launch there were some  performance issues, even on the Pro.  But the latest patch helped a lot.  I recommend playing on the quality setting as it's we above 60fps.  If you love souls-likes then you should really enjoy this!  I'm having a blast!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game deserves to be getting a lot more attention as the game is incredible!   And just goes to show how out of touch most modern critics are!  This game is as good as God of War imo.  It's made by Mercury Steam the guys behind Castlevania Lords of Shadow and Metroid.  It's got great graphics for one.  And they use they're own engine   Which is so nice with all the buggy, samey UE5 slop out there.  But the gameplay shines.  You have 7 weapon categories with 5 subtypes.  Each one will be effective against different things.  You scan enemies to see what they are susceptible to and where on the body you can hit.  You attack with the face buttons.  Triangle is head attack x is low, square is left and O is right.  Which I like.  This is more an action game than a souls-like.  Though you can parry.  The combat is brutal and visceral.  You make weapons at the forge.  This is a great aspect of the game.  So much fun and deep.  Don't be put off at first.  Stick with it and it becomes intuitive.  The game also has metroidvania aspects.  There is also a ton of enemy variety and bosses.  This game was such a surprise and will be in my GOTY contention!  Don't sleep on this game people!  It's great!!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This is peak AA gaming in my opinion.  And I mean that in the best way possible.  This is a really ambitious game for the small 10 person team who made the game. There's really a lot to like about the game.  The graphics are quite nice.  And the lore is interesting.  And the basecamp was well thought out and arranged.  The combat is fun most of the time and fairly engaging.  But the best part is the treasurw hunting and secrets.  They done a great job of creating all kinds of treasures that are worth differebt amounts and or can be used in myriad ways.  Particularly in upgrading your gear.  There's a nice little economy and social aspect with a day and night cycle.  As for the bad the game can be frustrating and rage inducing at times as the game can be quite punitive.  You can kill yourself with your own weopons for one.  Fir two enemies can and will heal frequently.  And if you get stuck in a world where your gear matches the affinity of the cartagram (the game's maps) enemies will be immune to your attacks.  So you may not be able to kill the stage boss because of the gear you have left.  Which can be frustrating.  Fortunately you keep most of your loot.  Finally there is some wokeness.  The character Izzy is an insufferable, girl-boss and many of the characters are off-putting.  But the weapons guy John, the bartender and the scientist lady are well done and likable.  But despite those issues the game has a certain charm that keeps pulling me back in.  I don't think I'll ever get tired of the treasure hunting and exploration!  Recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: All the people giving this a bad review clearly did not give it enough time nor do they comprehend how successes/progress occurs.  The game is brilliant.  You have the initial directive to find the 46th room in an ostensibly 45 room mansion.  So the goal is not just to get to the antechamber which leads to the 46th room but also to discover and draft new rooms.  Unlocking certain rooms unlock permanent buffs.  There are also outside grounds with mysteries as well as a story to piece together.  Stick with it.  The more you play the more it's fun and brilliance is revealed.  Also unlike many games today Blue Prince doesn't hold your hand.  It respects your intelligence to figure things out.  Highly recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: So I had no idea about this game until I saw the trailer.  And it was good.  It pulled me in.  And I thought, this looks better than Disney Star Wars!  And once I started playing it hooked me right in with a intriguing story and likable characters!  As I played more, the awesome gameplay had me hooked.  It's a turn based RPG but it keeps you focused and engaged with real time elements.  This entails pressing buttons at certain times to block attacks for lessening damage taken or to increase damage on attacks.  It's really quite fun.  It's also very well written.  Funny at times, poignant and endearing at others.  You can tell this game was made by people who truly put their heart and soul inro the game.  Another indie game that I felt that for was Animal Well.  So if you like quality RPGs or just well made games than check this out!  I really hope this dev makes another game!  I would love to see a sequel to this!

author: Exlee3000
quote: I'm really enjoying this game!  I love the graphics and art style.  It really makes you feel part of this dark, grimy and seedy world.  And the music and sound design are top-notch!  The music is a real stand out.  I also like how they present the game.  From the opening sequence to the cut scenes.  The gameplay is definitely souls influenced in the melee part.  But you play a spirit who can possess people for fighting these monsters called Slitterheads.  You have regular humans, but then you have special humans called rarities.  These rarities have special powers that can be upgraded.  They're powerful and fun to use.  Finally the story has been quite good and I can't wait to see how it ends.  Some people will have a problem with the scant voice acting and having to read text but I didn't mind it.  It's old school and unique and I'm glad this game exists!  It was the perfect pallate cleanser after the amazing GOTY candidate Metaphor ReFantazio.  This game won't be for everyone but it's definitely for me!  And ZERO DEI/ESG/W-ke nonsense!  Halellujah!

author: Exlee3000
quote: I had heard about this game but I had no intention of buying it.  Then on a whim I downloaded the demo and holy smokes this game blew me away!  The level of ambition and quality on display is amazing!  The gameplay is a fun mix of turn based and real time combat.  You can do damage to foes real time and if you hit them enough you can stun them.  Then when stunned all the advantages go your way.  However if you get hit first they have the advantage and you can easily get wiped out if you're not careful.  The world building, writing and voice acting are also phenomenal!  The all British cast  does a great job bringing all the characters to life and I really became immersed because of it.  Likewise the lore and world building could be ATLUS' best!  The music and art-design are also exemplary!  I went from barely knowing about this game to buying the 160 dollar collector's edition and being certain it will be a GOTY contender.  In fact I believe it will be considered an all-time great rpg as the years go by!!  Highly, highly recomended!  And good news!  If you didn't know there is a lengthy demo available on all store fronts!  It is between 4-6 hours and your save carries over to the real game! In an industry where western AAA studios like Ubisoft and EA churn out soulless, factory-line made forgettable games year after year.  A game like Metaphor is a very welcome huge breath of fresh air that epitomizes what makes videogames so great!

author: Exlee3000
quote: I really enjoyed The Plucky Squire.  It is a charming and wholesome game. At first the mechanics are a bit too simplistic but by the end there's a lot of cool stuff going on!  This game was obviously made to be wholesome entertainment for the family.  As such I think hardcore gamers may be a little bored here.  But for me it was a perfect pallate cleanser after playing Black Myth Wukong.  The last chapter and the final boss fight really elevated the game for me and left me with a fond impression of the game. Recommended! And if you have PS Plus extra it's included free, so check it out!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is pure brilliance! Clearly a game lovingly crafted by the devs and is a complete joy to play.  I had a smile on my face the entire time.  The gameplay is constantly mixed up to keep it interesting and there are amazing secrets everywhere!  I love how the last level of each stage is an homage to a classic playstation game.  The Ape Escape one was so fun.  This game is a love letter to all things playstation.  It was so fun seeing all the characters and devices from Playstations history.  I also have to make note of the awesome music.  So, so good!  With this massive success of this game and the colossal failure of Concord I hope Sony gets the message!  We don't want DEI/leftist propaganda games!  We play games for escapism and fun not to be bombarded with modern day nonsense!  Buy this game.  Speak with your wallet!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Thank God for asian game devs!  Asian devs and some indie devs have saved the industry imo.  Western devs packing their games with leftist propaganda have made them utterly insufferable for me. We play games for escapism not to be battered incessantly with the message!  Asian devs understand games should be fun and universal.  And the characters should be good looking!  Lies of P was my GOTY last year and that was made by Korean devs.  Stellar Blade was as well and that game was great also.  Now this from Chinese devs Game Science.  It was difficult at first to adjust to the dodge/perfect dodge mechanic in this game compared to the block/parry priority in the last souls-likes I've played.  But now I've got.  This game is amazing and looks fantastic.  The sound and music is also very good.  I'm loving the deep Chinese lore and aesthetic to the game.  The combat is also top notch!  Check it out!  I highly recommend it!

author: Exlee3000
quote: What a completely pleasant surprise.  Thr first thing that captures your attention are the amazing pixel graphics mixed with modern fog and transparencies.  The next thing that hooks you is the gameplay.  So many different and unique tools.  The next thing that hooks you are all the secrets and mysteries.  So, so many deep unique puzzles.  It very much reminded me of Tunic in that way.  A game which I also adore.  If you consider yourself a true gamer this game is for you!  It's truly legendary!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is such a breath of fresh air!  A game made with passion by the devs, completely free of the cultural marxism infesting and destroying modern gaming!  The graphics are great as is the music!  But the best part is the gameplay, top notch across the board and a blast to play!  The parry mechanic is at a different point than most souls-likes but once you adapt it's no problem.  They mix up the gameplay with some survival horror like sections which I quite enjoyed.  All said the game is highly recommended!  If you want an antidote to the w-ke nonsense ruining gaming, this game is for you!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is an absolute blast!  I had originally intended to play solo at first.  But I accidentally got grouped with 4 randoms.  I gave it a shot and it was some of the most fun I've had in a long time!  I rarely play co-op games and even less so with strangers.  But this game is structured in a way that encourages team work and camaraderie.  The weapons feel meaty and chunky and have equally awesome sound.  The graphics and music are also quite good.  I had no problem match making but I understand other people have!  All I can say is I will be playing this game with friends and strangers for a long time.  It really is that fun!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is the epitome of everything wrong with the videogame industry currently.  A full priced, always online looter shooter loaded with microtransactions.  The game is soulless and uninspired.  The music is some of the most generic I've ever heard.  The gameplay is boring and repetative.  The dialogue is as cringe as it comes and it's loaded witH DEI and ESG propaganda.  Finally the disrespect they show beloved legacy characters is nauseating.  Partucularly their very own Arkham-verse Batman as well as the Flash where they literally piss on him!  **** were a middle finger this would be it.  We need to show WB and this new terrible Rocksteady that we won't tolerate this insulting dog-water.  Do NOT supporrt this game or any like it.  It deserves to fail and fail miserably!
game_title: Suicide Squad: Kill The Justice League

author: Exlee3000
quote: Let me just say just this game is such a breath of fresh air!  It's a throwback to a time when games put entertainment, escapism and world building first and never had the devs personal propaganda in it!  Spiderman 2 was completely repulsive, fiilled with divisive identity politics and leftist propaganda.  The game was completely ruined for me.  This game has restored ny love of gaming.  Thank God the Asians undertand nobody wants that crap in their games!  As for Lies of P it is exemplary all around!  The world, graphics, sound/music and gameplay are all top notch!  As good as a From Soft game imo.  So if you want a great game free of the nonsense, this game is for you!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This is a great little indie title focused on nordic folklore.  First thing the graphics and art direction are top notch.  The character designs are creepy and effective.  Another high point is the music and sound design.  It really elevates the game.  In addition all the boss encounters are a highlight.  All were quite unique and fun.  One last point I want to make is this game is quite savage and gorey.  I don't mind it, but if you're sensitive to that sort of thing this may not be up your alley.  A game very similar to this is Little Nightmare.  If you liked those games than you will probably like this.  My only real complaint is the game is quite short.  You can easily beat it in a day as it clocks in around 6 hours.  But this was a nice change of pace after Jedi Survivor.  Really looking forward to their next game!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This is a great game.  The story, gameplay, music, art design and voice acting are top notch.  Yes the game has some performance issues but it's still very playable.  People giving it a zero is absurd.  On Ps5 the game runs just fine.

author: Exlee3000
quote: Everything about this game is top notch.  The graphics, 3D sound, music but most importantly the gameplay.  The risk reward mechanic of deciding which items to take a chance on is executed flawlessly.  The story is mysterious and compelling and giving just enough story to keep you pushing forward and feeling satisfied.  It's hard at first but very fair in my opinion.  By the end you will be a badass.  This game is in my top 20 all time games easily.  And with the Tower of Ascention dlc is infinitely playable.  Don't sleep on this masterpiece.

author: Exlee3000
quote: I wasn't going to buy this game at launch.  But then the w-ke lunatics demanded we boycott it because JK believes in biology.  So I bought the deluxe edition because I hate stupidity and w-keness.  And I'm sure glad I did because it's a fantastic game on all fronts.  The music, gameplay and graphics are all top notch.  I'm not even a Harry Potter fan, but you don't have to be as the game is so well done anyone can enjoy it!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Disappointing!  Was expecting it to much better given the long development cycle.  I think it's time for 343 to pass Halo to a new developer.  They have had three tries and have struck out.

author: Exlee3000
quote: Xbots giving this a zero really need to get a life.  The level of quality here is second to none.  I don't consider this a sequel but rather the second half of a duology.  Therefore I wasn't expecting radical changes to the game.  It is evolutionary in all the best ways.  Because this is essentially a ps4 game the graphics on Ps5 aren't as big of a leap that many had hoped.  But they are still amazing.  The benefit of this is that it has amazing framerate choices.  Up to 120 frames.  And very stable. The story and voice acting are also top notch.  Highly recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Well done survival horror game considering the small team and small resources.  The cult theme is unique to the genre.  Gameplay is solid as is the story.  Recommended!

author: Exlee3000
quote: A simply amazing experience in every way.  Aa good as any Mario game.  I pray they make a PSVR 2 sequel.

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is the epitome of everything wrong with the industry right now.  Woke garbage, buggy af and completely uninspired.  The characters are so bad you couldn't parody them better if you tried.  Laughably bad.  The writing is about as cringe as it comes.  Again laughably bad.  They changed a game that was edgy and politically incorrect to completely lame and pc.  The devs are completely out of touch.  They changed the essence of the game to complete woke trash.  Wokeness destroys every form of entertainment it touches.  And I will not stand for devs trashing their fans for rightful criticism.  When they first teased this game they showed a picture of thr first game, then they reemerged last year with this woke crap.  I hope this game fails miserably.  Avoid at all costs.

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game exceeded my expectations in every way.  The graphics were simply stunning.  The animation, top notch.  And the soundtrack and sound design were amazing.  I'm definitely going to pick up the soundtrack.  It's that good.  The gameplay and story keep you interested.  To top it all off the game is truly heartwarming; a beautiful tale of friendship and hope.  Don't miss this one.  This is what makes the medium so special!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Really enjoying this game.  The aesthetic is very colorful and stylish and really appeals to my eye.  The enemy variety is top notch and the game is populated some very cool ghosts.  The sidequests are very solid as well, with some being excellent.  Bosses are also a highlight.  Overall recommended.  I give it an 8.5.  But since some losers are giving this game a zero, which is ridiculous!  I gave it a 10 to counterbalance.

author: Exlee3000
quote: I really despise people who give clearly top quality games a zero.  These are clearly not playstation players.  It's a joke.  Am I annoyed about the always online, Yes!  Do I find the microtransactions super greedy, Yes!  Does this ruin an otherwise impeccably made game with zero bugs and is a return to form to the magic early days of the series, definitely NOT!  The game has always been grindy, but since it feels so good to race non of that matters.  All improved dramatically by the dualsense and 3D sound.  The weather in this game is arguably one of the best all time implementations in a game.  And there is literally a mountain of content here.  And it has infinite replay value with the multiplayer mode, which is essentially getting Gt Sport for free.  Kazanori Yamauchi is clearly the most inspired he has been since his days as a young 25 year old programmer whose vision for racing games would change the gaming industry and revive interest in certain parts of car culture.  The game is undeniably great, particularly newcomers.  This is an amazing game.

author: Exlee3000
quote: Ignore the ridiculous absurdly low scores by some trolls/haters.  The game was well worth the wait.  It runs great on Ps5.  Can't wait to get all the different endings.  Check it out, you will enjoy it.
game_title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

author: Exlee3000
quote: The game is not a 1, that's ridiculous.  To the people doing that kindly get real.  This game looks great and I like the new direction they went.  Looking forward to seeing all the different endings!  Well done.
game_title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

author: Exlee3000
quote: Let me start by saying this game is not going to be for everyone.  But for me I really appreciated what the devs did here.  From my understanding it was essentially just two guys, with assistance for music and a few other things.  I really enjoyed the world and culture they've created.  They even went through the trouble of creating a new language for the game, which really helps with immersion.  Essentially the game is an adventure game where you are a scout following the mythical hymnwave which is said will lead your people to a new homeland.  Once there you and a few other begin exploring and analyzing this wonderous new planet.  You are to catalogue the new flora and fauna you discover as well as tracking the aforementioned hymnwave.  You use the titular Jett to accomplish this.  It takes a little bit to get accostomed to the controls, which are unusual. I suspect many people will not like them.  But for me it worked.  The game really felt like what it must have been like to be a member of the crew on Star Trek.  For people who like unique indie games this could be something you'd like.  I'm really enjoying it.

author: Exlee3000
quote: This a perfect remaster in my opinion.  I love the old school hardcore nature of this.  It's really dark and I love that.  The graphics are really great.  The music is amazing.  I'm glad they left the essence of the game in tact.  Ignore the haters, this game is quality.

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is truly something special!  From the graphics which are stunning.  To the soundtrack which is so whimsical, endearing, and inviting.  To the varied and fun combat, to the many ways of traversing these lush environments.  Ignore the idiotic low critic and audience scores.  Giving this game less than 8 should be a crime!  Play this game, you won't be disappointed.

author: Exlee3000
quote: To the clowns giving this game a zero, you are despicable!  This game is quality through and through.  This is one of the best metroidvanias I've played in a while.  But it's just a good game, period.  The graphics are so good.  Each new location is beautifully realized.  The sound and music is top notch as well.  There is a spot where a character plays you an acoustic song and it's awesome!  The true star of the show is the combat!  It is so fun.  You get tons of combos and finshers called executions.  You start with your big metal fist which is awesome for combat and breakung through to find secret areas.  There are also 2 other augmentations to your fist that totally change combat and traversal.  And they are all great.  There are also cool upgrades that open up the world even more which leads to more areas and secrets.  The game loop is so fun.  To make it all even better the artwork is so, so good.  The anthropomorphic characters are all amazing.  It makes it a joy to meet each new character.  Finally the voice acting and localization is really, really solid.  Everything comes together to make an extremely polished and fun experience.  I would rate the game a 9 but because some losers who haven"t played the game gave it a zero I'm giving it a 10.  Highly recommended.  Support this awesome game!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is an instant classic.  Gameplay is addicting and fun.  The graphics are amazing.  But perhaps the best part of the game is the 3D sound and next level dualsense support.  The 3D sound is so good you feel like you are there.  The haptics and adaptive triggers blow away even Astro's Playroom.  This game truly feels next gen.  To all the clowns giving this a zero you are a bunch of pathetic jokes.  Or the one fool who called the devs arrogant because they made the game they wanted.  No you are arrogant sir.  This is an early GOTY contender and elevates Housemarque to the next level as devs.  So excited to see what they do next.  Sony needs to buy them immediately! They have proven to be something truly special!

author: Exlee3000
quote: There's no other way to say it, this game is a straight up masterpiece.  The creativity on display here by Remedy is stunning.  The story and plot are like x-files crossed with David Lynch.  The gameplay is so good as well.  Each new power and gun is so satisfying.  By the end you feel like a God with your powers!  I'm playing on the Ps5 and the graphics are stunning, especially at 60 fps.  If you have not played this game, pick it up now!  This is one of the best games ever made in my opinion.

author: Exlee3000
quote: To all the xbots giving this game a zero or a 2 or 3, I say to you , get a life.  For real.  I'm sorry your company doesn't give a crap about making any good games for you at launch.  The care and love that went into this remake us astonishing.  And yes it's a remake because they remade every single asset from the previous game.  This is the game that started it all and I love how bold and quirky this game is!  No hand holding here.  And the art direction and music is out if this world.  Never has a game given a feeling of such accomplishment.  When you finally beat a troublesome demanding boss you know you earned it.  And it will almost always be accompanied by a loud hell yeah.  The game is an all time classic.  Just know what you're getting into.  This game demonstrates the old adage, you can accomplish anything when you put your mind to it!

author: Exlee3000
quote: Absolutely loving this game!  After the nightmare that was TLOU 2.  It's nice to have a game that doesn't disrespect it's characters or it's players.  First of all the game is stunning looking, with an insane draw distance!  To me this is the best looking open world game.  This game is about stopping and smelling the roses, viewing the incredible sights, and being a badass samurai.  Combat is so fun.  Play this game!  Always loved **** Punch but this game moves them into the top tier of game development!  Forget the lazy reviews that say this is nothing more than an AC clone.  Nonsense this game has a ton of original features.  I can't wait to see how a  Ps5 patch will make this game shine even more.  I can only imagine what a Ps5 sequel would look like!  Buy this game!  Support quality!

author: Exlee3000
quote: This game is truly one of the worst sequels of all time.  Naughty Dog completely disrespects the characters and the players who liked the first game.  Joel's treatment in the game is a disgrace.  The wrting is embarrassingly bad and cringe many points in the game.  The worst part is how they made Elle a jerk.  Avoid this game if you loved the first one.  To say nothing of the SJW and feminist agenda.  Every significant male character gets killed.  While the diverse stunning and brave females survive.  It's laughable!!
